preconditions.description: Length of s1 is between 1 and 5000.

preconditions.expression: all(5 <= len(s) < 25 for s in s1)
preconditions.description: Each string in s1 has a length between 5 and 24.

preconditions.expression: all(5 <= len(s) < 25 for s in s2)
